## Summary

Describe the release metadata, channel or documentation change.

## Safety checks

- [ ] No application source code is included
- [ ] No binary/archive is committed directly to Git
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, customer data or private network information are included
- [ ] `release-index.json` remains valid
- [ ] Product channel JSON remains valid
- [ ] Release tags and URLs use the correct product namespace
- [ ] Download/security documentation remains accurate
